identity_evidence: ACROS Fukuoka identifies the facility as the public-private international, cultural and information exchange complex opened on 29 April 1995 at 1-1-1 Tenjin, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka.
The official role table assigns formal design to Nihon Sekkei and Takenaka Corporation, while assigning the basic concept to Nihon Sekkei, Takenaka Corporation and Emilio Ambasz.

The official program includes the symphony hall, event and conference halls, shops, restaurants, offices, galleries and the publicly accessible Step Garden. Emilio Ambasz is preserved as a basic-concept contributor rather than incorrectly recorded as the sole architect.
